name: M5.recovery_inclusion_positive
statement: ∀ (total excluded included : ℕ), total = excluded + included → 0 < total → excluded = 0 → 0 < included
guidance: Auxiliary lemma from original M5 proof section 3: A positive completion count survives by inclusion when exclusion has zero completions. This is only the branch-partition arithmetic step. Exactness of the completion formula and the partition identity are not assumed proven by this node. Preserve the exact target. This node alone does not prove M5.
